message.content:
B. minimal tropospheric ozone formation.

Nighttime rural areas lack strong sunlight and often have lower anthropogenic sources, so photochemical ozone formation is minimal. Large VOC emissions and rapid NOx accumulation are not the best expectations.

Single-word palindromes (5+ letters): kayak, level, radar, rotor, madam, civic, tenet, stats, reviver, repaper, rotator.
